title: Chapter 885
text:
While he was at it, he counted the number of times he had applied for leave. Looking at the calendar, this was the second time this year. There were 365 days in a year. Last year, he applied for leave a total of 15 times, which added up to about half a month. This year, he would try to keep the number of days he applied for leave below seven times.

One Day of Leave for Godly Mechanic (2/7)
